name: American Mahjong Retreat at Canyon Ranch Lenox
description: Multi-day mahjong retreats at Canyon Ranch Lenox with Gold Coast Mahjong Club instructors. Official retreat page: beginners receive "a NMJL card and will have instructor support throughout the first few sessions" and the Oct 2026 page says beginners receive "your National Mah Jongg League card" in the Mahjong 101 bootcamp. Resort stay required.
schedule: Periodic 3-day retreats (2026: Jul 12-14 and Oct 26-28 already held); lodging from $1575-$1750 per person per night; optional Mahjong 101 bootcamp $195
